description: This file defines the TpmKeymasterContext class, which implements a KeymasterContext that integrates with a TPM (Trusted Platform Module). It includes class declarations, member variables, and method signatures related to TPM-based key management, attestation, and system version handling.

classes.name: TpmKeymasterContext
classes.description: A class that extends keymaster::KeymasterContext to provide TPM-based key management and attestation functionalities.

methods.name: GetKmVersion
methods.description: Returns the Keymaster version from the attestation context.

methods.name: SetSystemVersion
methods.description: Sets the system's OS version and patch level.

methods.name: GetSystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the system's OS version and patch level.

methods.name: GetKeyFactory
methods.description: Returns the key factory for a specified algorithm.

methods.name: GetOperationFactory
methods.description: Returns the operation factory for a specified algorithm and purpose.

methods.name: GetSupportedAlgorithms
methods.description: Provides the list of supported algorithms.

methods.name: UpgradeKeyBlob
methods.description: Upgrades a key blob to a newer format.

methods.name: ParseKeyBlob
methods.description: Parses a key blob into a key object.

methods.name: GenerateAttestation
methods.description: Generates an attestation certificate chain for a key.
